course.title: Manufacturing Process - I
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: In a paint processing industry, a worker is assigned to a job of placing 15Kg paint jar from the conveyor to rack. The height of the conveyor is 30 cm and the included angle with sagital plane is $0 ^ { 0 } .$ . The height of the rack is 100 cm and included angle is $3 0 ^ { 0 }$ . The diameter of the paint jar is 25 cm and height is 28 cm. The frequency of the job is 3 lifts/min. The duration of work is 8 hours which result a multiplier of 0.55. Assuming the coupling as fair, calculate the RWL and LI at the origin and destination. Also mention the limitations of revised NIOSH lifting equation.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
